open_findings.expected: The production apply must fail closed whenever a data key differs from its recorded preflight snapshot, and the contract must state the same rule.
open_findings.minimal_repair: Remove the drift bypass; on any mismatch, stop and repeat the read-only --check to make a new private record before applying. Add a static negative control proving a moved key cannot be overridden.
open_findings.observed: The apply command accepts --allow-count-drift and proceeds when snapshot data keys changed since --check. T7 and the task contract require the recent record to match live business counts; the flag bypasses that guard without another recorded baseline or owner decision.

regression_proof.description: A constructed recorded/live count mismatch must refuse the apply path even when an extra drift flag is supplied; no database contact is needed.

open_findings.expected: The post-migration matrix must verify the exact grants and the absence of unintended recipients, including the 010 REVOKEs and the full owner column set.
open_findings.minimal_repair: Compare all non-owner ACL recipients on the four new tables and six functions with the reviewed allowlist, explicitly check the Supabase API roles where present, and compare owner UPDATE column names rather than count alone. Add constructed negative controls for an extra recipient and a swapped owner column.
open_findings.observed: V17 filters table grants to names matching ascend_%, and V16 aggregates only those names plus PUBLIC. A grant to anon, authenticated, service_role, or another non-Ascend role is ignored, although 010 explicitly revokes Supabase API-role defaults. V21 checks only the owner column-grant count, so replacing one allowed owner column with another also passes.

regression_proof.description: Static/catalog-fixture tests must make the matrix fail on an extra anon or authenticated grant and on an owner-column substitution with the same count.

open_findings.expected: Both migration tools must reject SSL URL overrides and malformed or missing direct endpoint input before opening a connection.
open_findings.minimal_repair: Apply the same explicit URL-parameter and required-input checks to the read-only verifier, with a focused static refusal test.
open_findings.observed: The apply script refuses SSL-related URL parameters before connecting, but verify-migration-010.mjs parses ASCEND_DATABASE_URL_DIRECT without that refusal. The task requires the same direct-endpoint and pinned-TLS input guard for the migration scripts.

regression_proof.description: A constructed direct URL containing sslmode or sslrootcert must be rejected by the verifier before connection.

open_findings.expected: The production rollout must not claim a complete two-role smoke unless a real sanctioned partner principal was tested. If partner credentials are unavailable, report the dependency and stop before authorizing the deployment instead of recording a skipped security check as success.
open_findings.minimal_repair: Make the partner checks a mandatory pass condition in baseline and post modes for this rollout, or stop and seek a separate explicit Coordinator/human decision if a production partner login does not yet exist. Cover absence of the partner input as a failing case.
open_findings.observed: Partner login and authorization checks run only with --partner, while T1/T11 mark it optional and D4 allows it to be skipped. The task's SMOKE manual check requires owner and partner login and owner-only controls to be exercised as part of the rollout smoke; the command can currently report success without any partner proof.

regression_proof.description: A baseline or post smoke invoked without partner input must fail rather than report a complete rollout smoke.

required_manual_checks.description: The contract makes the already-promoted 2A.1c-2A.2e Sales stack live and nothing else: apply 010_sales_actions.sql and deploy one pinned, promoted baseline SHA. No new Sales behavior, dashboard, pipeline, notes or promotion change, and no unrelated production change. It names the exact deploy SHA and tree to be re-pinned at authorization time, and the 010 SHA-256 as pinned in core/recovery/profile-registry.ts.

Document, with file and line evidence, why migrate and deploy must be ONE stopped-service window. 010 revokes sales UPDATE of status/assigned_to/first_contact/last_contact, replaces the owner's table UPDATE with column grants, and adds prospects_status_has_transition. The serving D1 build (ba648d3) marks promotion with a direct `UPDATE prospects SET status = 'closed-won'` (core/db/prospects.ts:523), which 010 denies. The promoted build cannot run on 009 (the Sales reads need the 010 tables). Verify every other D1 write path against the 010 grants, and confirm the new build needs no environment name production lacks. Order: bootout, migrate, verify, build, bootstrap, smoke. The D1 .next rollback clone is NOT a valid rollback after 010. Also correct, in the contract, the preflight's claim that promotion bypasses the stage command: markProspectPromoted already calls ascend_transition_stage with cause 'promotion' (core/db/prospects.ts:517).

Specify a fresh pre-migration backup of production and its recovery proof. The orchestrator's `prove --owner` selects only the registry's pinned CURRENT artifact (post-009 v2), so a fresh v3 artifact must be proven with the sanctioned runner `scripts/recovery-verify.sh --artifact <fresh> [--r1c-root]` (R1b then R1c, same-version 17.6), plus the post-restore profile expected for ledger 009. Include the after-artifact for ledger 010 verified against post-010-v1. No new recovery authority.

Specify owner-run read-only production checks using the existing pinned-TLS, BEGIN READ ONLY pattern (counts only). BEFORE: ledger exactly 001-009 with recorded checksums; no 010 objects present; the prospect count and the no-transition-needed state recorded; no application session holding locks. AFTER: ledger 001-010 with 010's checksum equal to the pinned value; the four Sales tables, three SECURITY DEFINER functions (empty search_path), the trigger, RLS forced, and the exact grant set; business row counts unchanged. The migration goes through the existing migrate path only, alone in its window.

Extend scripts/deploy-smoke.mjs with Sales checks. Read-only checks (run automatically): owner and partner login, /sales queue renders bounded sections, /sales/list, a prospect detail, owner controls present for the owner and absent for the partner, no missing-relation errors. Write checks (contact, follow-up, owner reassign/reopen) are OFF by default and run only under an explicit owner flag, because production contacts and events are append-only. Keep the documented email-via-env input (no in-script prompt, per the D1 keep-alive race). Add a static test for the smoke's check list and its write-flag gate, and classify it in gate-2g1.ts.

State per-step stop conditions and recovery. Before migration: abort, no change. Migration fails or verification mismatches: stop, keep the service down, and restore from the fresh artifact only on explicit owner decision. After deploy: forward-fix; a restore loses writes made since the backup and needs owner approval. Serving-tree preconditions: clean tree at the pinned SHA; the uncommitted apps/os/next.config.ts reverted; iCloud ' 2'/' 3' duplicates removed from source and .next; no other session or dev server using the main checkout.

Add scripts/apply-migration-010.mjs and scripts/verify-migration-010.mjs, modelled exactly on the reviewed 009 pair. Direct endpoint only; pinned TLS; refuse SSL URL parameters; a frozen 010 SHA-256 equal to the profile registry's L010; exactly one migration applied; ledger exactly 001-009 with zero checksum drift before; every 010 object absent before; a row-count guard; importing only core/db/migrate.ts. The default `--check` is read-only (default_transaction_read_only=on) and applying requires an explicit production flag. The verify matrix is frozen before execution and is read-only: ledger/checksum, four tables, RLS forced, policies, the exact grants (including the REVOKEs on prospects), three SECURITY DEFINER functions with empty search_path, the trigger, and unchanged business counts. Static tests must prove the checksum pin, the refusal paths and the read-only default without any database.

scripts/backup-production.sh A5 (lines 121-125) refuses unless production's ledger equals every file in core/db/schema. From a 010 tree it therefore refuses to back up 009 production. The contract must specify taking the pre-migration backup from a separate clean worktree at a named commit whose schema directory ends at 009 and whose profile registry has the post-009 profile, then the after-backup from the deploy SHA once 010 is applied. Do not weaken A5.

Diff limited to the write paths. No production contact, migration, deployment or credential access by the builder. Execution is a separate owner-authorized task (2A.3a-2) that follows this contract exactly.

title: 2A.3a-1 Production Rollout Contract, 010 Apply/Verify Scripts and Sales Smoke (no production contact)
